crossRefs.note: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes…
Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there…
But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea…
As Yahweh your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is…
for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
“Their feet are swift to shed blood.
Destruction and misery are in their ways.
When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…

translations.web: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”
translations.bsb: Observe and find out all the places where he hides. Then come back to me with certainty, and I will go with you. If he is in the land, I will search him out among all the clans of Judah.”
translations.kjv: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.
translations.asv: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking-places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me of a certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.
